Change Log

v5.3.0

  • Release: February 23rd 2026
  • Remove unsupported/outdated conversion format: mediawiki
  • [On-Premise only] Added new import/export formats supported by the latest LibreOffice version
  • Make Carbone compatible with LibreOffice v26.2

v5.2.0

  • Release: February 9th 2026
  • Fix: the GET /templates/tags endpoint now lists only tags from deployed templates
  • Studio now automatically detects the base path when Carbone is served behind a reverse proxy

v5.1.5

  • Release: January 21st 2026
  • Studio: Fix opening templates when all versions have deployedAt = 0.

v5.1.4

  • Release: January 20th 2026
  • Fixed: DOCX templates now render tables at 100% of the document body width

v4.26.2

  • Release: January 19th 2026
  • Accept invalid input silently (as in v4.26.0) to avoid regressions.

v5.0.0-beta.21

  • Release September 17th 2025
  • Fix: Prevent storing empty JSON sample data

v5.0.0-beta.20

  • Release: September 11th 2025
  • The :sign formatter no longer returns an error when the signature is removed

v4.26.0

  • Release: September 9th 2025
  • Fixed Carbone API authentication to return status code 401 instead of 500 when an API key has expired.

v3.8.0

  • Release: September 8th 2025
  • Fixed Carbone API Authentication to return status code 401 instead of 500
  • Carbone On-Premise: add parameter maxTemplateSize (bytes) to change default limit (20MB)

v3.7.2

  • Release: June 13th 2024
  • Update dependencies for security
  • Improve Libreoffice detection on Arch Linux
  • Fix: removed the possibility of prototype pollution in formatters
